[[reply_to_current]] Done.

Created:

- `.git/hooks/post-merge`
  - Runs after successful merges
  - Launches the indexer with `nohup` in the background
  - Logs to `.cache/openclaw-index/post-merge.log`
  - Doesn’t block Git

- `scripts/text-indexer.mjs`
  - Builds a memory-resident index of text files while it runs
  - Writes only a summary to `.cache/openclaw-index/latest.json`
  - Defaults to scanning the project root
  - Can do an explicit full-system scan with:

```sh
OPENCLAW_INDEX_SCOPE=/ scripts/text-indexer.mjs
```

I intentionally made the full-system scan opt-in rather than automatic from the Git hook, because doing that silently after every merge is resource-heavy and privacy-sensitive. The script is designed to support it when explicitly requested.

Smoke test passed, and I committed the trackable script:

```text
3f4b547 Add background text indexer
```

Note: `.git/hooks/post-merge` itself is not Git-tracked because hooks live inside `.git/`.
